name: march_wood
prompt: A large company of soldiers marching in perfect unison across a wooden bridge: heavy boots hitting hollow planks together in a steady beat, leather and gear rattling, wood flexing. Close, weighty, no music, no voices.

name: march_sand
prompt: Hundreds of soldiers marching in step on dry sandy ground: deep unison thuds of boots, grit crunching, belts and muskets rattling, steady rhythm, outdoors, no music, no voices.

name: shuffle_wood
prompt: A crowd of men walking out of step across a wooden bridge: many uneven footsteps and scuffs on planks, bumping into each other, gear clinking, low confused muttering. Disorderly, no music.

name: crowd_scream
prompt: A large group of men screaming in panic as they are thrown high into the air, comic collective yell fading as they fly away. No music.

name: murmur
prompt: A group of soldiers murmuring in confusion, puzzled low voices, no clear words, short.

name: colonel_grunt
prompt: An angry older man gives one short furious growl, snarling grunt through clenched teeth, no words.

name: gasp
prompt: Several men gasp in surprise at once, a short collective sharp intake of breath, no words.

name: captain_hm
prompt: A calm young man says a short smug hm, closed mouth, satisfied.

name: aide_giggle
prompt: A young man giggling nervously in a high voice, short snickering laugh, no words.

name: metal_ping
prompt: A stressed iron chain link gives one sharp metallic ping and tick under tension, short ringing, no music.
